added_lines: saturday 24th october cul vigil 6pm james & peggy green; & dec’d members of the lynch & green families; saturday 24th october dunsh vigil 7pm lil & gerry o’sullivan; sunday 25th october dunsh 12noon michael mannion & dec’d family members; saturday 31st october cul vigil 6pm ray, kitty & robert enraght – moony; saturday 31st october dunsh vigil 7pm frances & sean gallagher; culmullen church phase 1 of the restoration is now complete, the scaffolding has been taken dow n and the church grounds are re- instated as before. we thank all involved, architect, liam mulligan, kells, summerville contra ctors, ltd, evan connan, stained glass, damien minnock, heating installation. the total cost to date is two hundred and twenty five thousand euro. we thank all who supported the project through the weekly envelope collections, standing orders or special donations in response to our fundraising campaign. contributions are encouraged as phase 2 of the works will commence next spring. the next phase will involve re-pointing the exterior walls with lime ands and in accordance with heritage specifications. a christmas concert is planned for culmullen church for 18th december next, proceeds will go towards the restoration. sycamore programme pastoral centre dunshaughlin continues on mondays at 7:30pm. to register email
